lines.text: Every December, Leo bought his sister another hiking gadget.
Every January, it sat in a drawer, still in the box.
What she wanted was time on the trail together.
Here's the fix. Give a hike, not a thing.
Write a coupon: sunrise hike, I drive, I carry the snacks.
Then plan it together: the trail, a turnaround time, a weather check.
In January they finally hiked together.
Save this for your gift list.
